climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Pinot Gris sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A Côte de Beaune village appellation making about two-thirds white wine from Chardonnay and one-third red from Pinot Noir. It has three Grand Crus, Montrachet being the best known, and 50 Premier Cru vineyards.
